oneLine: Iveco shareholders approve Tata Motors' takeover bid, cashing out existing shareholders.

sources.title: Iveco shareholders approve Tata Motors' takeover bid; acceptance threshold cut to 80 pc

synopsis: Shareholders of Italian commercial vehicle maker Iveco Group approved key resolutions related to Tata Motors' takeover offer at an extraordinary general meeting in Amsterdam, including reducing the minimum acceptance threshold from 95 per cent to 80 per cent of its common shares. Tata Motors previously announced plans to acquire Iveco, excluding its defence business, for around EUR 3.8 billion, nearly Rs 38,240 crore, through TML CV Holdings Pte Ltd. The offer price was raised by EUR 0.30 per share to EUR 14.40. The tender offer acceptance period runs from September 7 to October 26, 2026. Approvals included amendments to articles of association, appointment of board members following settlement, changes to special voting shares, and potential post-offer demerger or conversion into a private limited liability company.
